title: reflection block props
description: « Réflexion »: a prompt the learner answers in their own words (text) or on a scale (scale). Never scored: it counts as answered once saved. Saving shows a confirmation and, when model is given, an expert's answer to compare with. With download, a button gives « Mes réponses », a text file of every reflection of the course made in the browser.
x-ai-instructions: Use it to make learners connect the content to their own work (self-explanation, generative learning): ask about a situation they know (« Pensez à la dernière fois qu'un client… : qu'auriez-vous fait autrement ? »), not for a definition the text gives. One clear question per block, after the content it builds on; a few per module. text (default): give model, an expert's short answer written as an example to compare with, not as the right answer; keep maxLength near 500 (each character counts in the LMS's saved data, see E_SUSPEND_DATA_BUDGET). scale: a self-assessment (confidence, frequency, agreement) with minLabel and maxLabel saying what the ends mean; five points by default. Turn download on in modules whose reflections learners keep (a plan of action).

presentation.description: text: the learner writes. scale: the learner picks a point from scale.min to scale.max.

prompt.description: The question, tied to the learner's own experience.

maxLength.description: text: the longest answer, in characters. The build counts it in the LMS's saved data as a persisted string variable.

rows.description: text: the height of the field, in lines.

model.description: An expert's answer, shown once the learner has saved theirs, to compare with.

download.description: Offer « Mes réponses »: a text file of every reflection of the course and the learner's answers, made in the browser (nothing is sent).

scale.description: scale: the points offered, and what their ends mean.

max.description: SCORM 1.2 records a likert answer as one character: 9 at most.

minLabel.description: What the lowest point means (Pas du tout).

maxLabel.description: What the highest point means (Tout à fait).

objective.description: Plan objective the reflection serves (recorded with its interaction).
